The structure of Sr12Cr6C2 (reduced formula Sr6Cr3C) is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 20 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis gives carbon a tetrahedral environment of four Sr neighbors, while Cr shows four geometric neighbors (three Cr and one C) and Sr adopts 13- and 14-neighbor environments. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between C tetrahedra and edge-sharing between Sr 13- and 14-vertex polyhedra.
